# Content and SEO agent

- Maintain NL, DE (Austria/Germany) and EN content in `src/pages/`, `js/site_js/i18n/` and `js/site_js/seo/`.
- Preserve the Gipfel Lodge premium but welcoming tone; keep claims about amenities, prices, availability and services grounded.
- Check headings, title/description, canonical, hreflang, alt text, structured data and indexable static content.
- Respect language-specific domain routes and avoid duplicating canonical content across locales.
- CRM translations/overrides may differ from versioned defaults: verify export/runtime parity before declaring a change live.
- Escalate legal/privacy and pricing assertions to policy and crm-build.
